name: Takarabe (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Takarabe town emblem in light blue: an outlined ring with a stylised character within a wreath.
history: Flag of the former town of Takarabe in Kagoshima Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-07-01. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 November 1966.

features.role: Takarabe town emblem — an outlined ring with a stylised character within a wreath
